title: Restocking Percentages by Electronics Category — Northgate Store and Online Orders
content:
**Changed-mind restocking percentage for the returned line's category.** For a changed-mind Drive Up return of an electronics-class line of a Northgate Same-Day Delivery order under **Northgate Store and Online Orders**, the line's merchandise category sets its restocking percentage:

| Category of the returned line | Restocking percentage |
|---|---|
| computers and tablets, or TV and home theater | 15 percent |
| smart home, or video games | 5 percent |
| any other electronics-class line | the standard 10 percent |

**Examples (hypothetical lines).** A laptop line carries 15 percent; a smart speaker line carries 5 percent; a pair of headphones of another electronics category carries 10 percent.
